name: ratio_whole_side_denominator
mechanism: The two red endpoint markers identify numerator XQ while the blue entire XY side suggests a denominator span XY in place of QY, inviting XQ/XY=2/5, choice A. All named original points remain readable; no region boundary or counting target is added.
primary_math_proof: Let h be Q height above the base, with unit grid coordinates P=(0,0),X=(5,2),Y=(5,1). The lower portion comprises the rightmost unit square plus the triangle of base5 and height h. Thus 1+5h/2=10/2 gives h=8/5. XQ=2/5 and QY=3/5, so the required ratio is2/3, uniquely D. Endpoint markers coincide with existing marked points and do not add area or alter any edge.
